source.access: read-only; the source repository was not written

owner_decision.summary: interactive Claude Code's existing human-auth path only; the current Japanese PR body format is kept; no bulk open-pr migration, legacy template or Japanese-ratio enforcement

intentional_diff.from_source: Ported in spirit, not verbatim: the reference selection (select_linked_issue_reference), the A1 decision-comment fact fetch and the Draft `gh pr create --repo --head --base main --body-file`. find_existing_pr is NOT ported: the source returns None for both a failed lookup and an absent PR, which would turn a lookup failure into a duplicate create.
not_ported: PR template and the 9 legacy headings
LP050-LP058 general lint and the Japanese ratio validator
canonical API full_name / rename alias resolution

failure_semantics.pr_lookup: existing | absent | stop. A failed, non-JSON, truncated (>=100), multi-match, foreign-owner / cross-repository or other-base result is a stop with zero writes.
failure_semantics.create: exactly one `gh pr create`; a failure, timeout or unparseable result is never retried and reports only a read-only probe.
failure_semantics.evaluator: decision must be closing_required / nonclosing_required with body_verdict valid; exit 0 of the evaluator is not permission.
failure_semantics.race: a concurrent PR creation between the lookup and the create is not excluded.

count_evidence: Measured with pytest --co and a real run; the runner independently verifies per-file counts and JUnit outcome. Behavioural tests drive the real open_pr.py CLI against an isolated Git repository and a fake gh; they verify no live GitHub behaviour.

earlier_slice_sync.rule: The absence assertions for open-pr/SKILL.md and scripts/open_pr.py became presence/migration records; update_pr.py stays absent. Each manifest keeps its previous record under historical_pre_d11 and gains migrated_by_d11. Totals, source pins and deferred records are untouched.

rollback: Revert the single D11 PR: it removes the Skill, open_pr.py, this manifest, the D11 closure and CI lane and restores the D3-D8 records. D7 validate_pr_body.py and the D9 main state are not modified.
ci_binding: The d11 job runs this manifest through scripts/ci/run_stage1b1_tests.py and the full tests/stage_i4 directory; no new permissions, runner or secrets.
